bagPolicy.summary: Small bags up to 5" x 8" x 1" are allowed, including clutches, wristlets, clear bags, fanny packs and small purses. Large bags are prohibited.
allowed: Clutches, wristlets, clear bags, fanny packs and small purses up to 5" x 8" x 1"
bagPolicy.note: Medical equipment bags and parenting bags under 14" x 14" x 6" are allowed after metal detection screening and search. Bags cannot be stored at the venue; prohibited items must be discarded or returned to your vehicle.

parking.summary: Preferred parking is available for concerts and shows, and accessible parking is in the Preferred Parking Lot and the General Parking areas. Buying parking in advance on Ticketmaster saves money over paying on site. Overnight parking and tailgating are not permitted, and Hersheypark Season Passes don't cover parking.

rideshare.note: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by GIANT Center. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: GIANT Center is cashless and takes all major credit and debit cards. To turn cash into a prepaid debit card at no fee, use the Cash-to-Card kiosks in the Box Office lobby or on the concourse outside the Hershey Sports store.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: If you have specific accessibility questions or concerns, please contact Box Office Customer Service directly at 717-534-3300, TTY 717-534-8955. Accessible parking is located in the Preferred Parking Lot and in the General Parking areas.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: You cannot return using the same ticket after leaving. A new ticket is required for re-entry.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Concerto hasn't confirmed GIANT Center's box office and will call details from an official source yet. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at GIANT Center. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
